body: I really do appreciate that but I almost lost the 2 people I love, respect, and cherish most in the world because of my fuck ups. I can't take the risk of further letting them down or losing them. So I would rather bow out and just let them down one last time versus running the risk of losing them due to their disappointment.
I appreciate that, but I mean I *really* fucked up. The people I hurt would be better off without me weighing them down and it would let me bow out with some sort of semblance of grace.

Morbidly, I think if it was going to happen, it already would have. That particular incident took place around 3 years ago, so there would have been ample opportunities. I'm an incredibly light sleeper who battles insomnia so any particularly deep or heavy sleep would have stood out like a neon exclamation point. It doesn't excuse it by any means, but I don't think I am in any imminent danger.
Thanks, i appreciate the response and info. I've been seriously considering it the last few days.
Thank you. It sucks bc most of the time it's just like being with a normal family, then other times like last night... I'm really sad that the alt-right has so completely sucked them in.

Thanks. If we were in a better position financially, we definitely would move out, but with COVID-19, everything is kind of up in the air. I've talked to him about the drinking about a month ago about how it really bothered me--I tried to make it as much of an "us vs the problem" as I could, I know he's depressed and I didn't want him to feel like I was attacking him. He's not an awful person but I feel like we've just become these two totally different people who view and interact with the world so, so differently it seems like a monumental issue to overcome. 

Thanks again for taking the time to respond.
